items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: I think maybe Cy St. Clair might have been on tuba.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear Baby and Bunk together in that last trip that he made in 47 there, you know, with the caravan days? I know they played once or twice with Pops Foster, maybe with Hodes or somebody down on someplace like the Roseland or one of those other Arcadia ball, some other ballroom there, right off of Broadway, I think. I don't remember. A special thing one night. Did you hear him?

I don't remember. I know we had two bands toward the end of that caravan engagement. Maybe Baby was the other drummer. Uh. Toward the end we split the thing into two bands, and I think Bunk had one band. Bunk was a trumpet for one band and I was a trumpet for the other. I think we split it up that way. Uh. And, uh. So maybe he was playing with Baby then. I seem to recall that he was. I think he might very well might have been. I think, unless I'm getting all this mixed up together now, I think maybe Cy St. Clair…
Well, did you ever hear Mutt, uh, change the subject, did you ever hear Mutt play in New York that engagement? Uh. That, uh, that, uh, year. I think I heard Mutt sit in, I believe, somewhere.
